VID thresholds: training size and prediction accuracy

9 October 2026

Finding: lower thresholds added training profiles but produced only small, mixed accuracy gains. 6.6/6.6 was retained for the u/v feature experiment. These historical threshold models do not include u/v. No threshold consistently improved transfer to unseen sites.

A cutoff of T/T means whole-profile VID ≥ T and observed-upper VID ≥ T (birds/km²). All models were evaluated on identical profiles from the original 6.6/6.6 population.

Mean raw-density RMSE over the five depths, 100–500 m; lower is better. Units: birds/km³. Counts are unique contributing training profiles, not expanded rows.

Methods and limits

  • Sampling: up to three distinct measured targets per profile/depth. At 100–500 m, use 75% window-prioritized and 25% uniform sampling; deeper targets retain uniform sampling. All predictors exclude bins below the observed edge.
  • Fixed model: 38 features, including AGL, latitude/longitude and upper VID; cube-root normalized density; upper-VID training weights. Stopping minimizes mean raw-density RMSE across 100–500 m on separate, fixed stopping nights.
  • Different preparation: 7–10 filter existing sampled rows. 3–5 rebuild hourly representatives and resample targets with the same preferences. Lower-threshold sets are therefore not nested; these are practical configuration comparisons.
  • Interpretation: 3/3 adds 31.9% more training profiles, but does not consistently improve unseen-site accuracy. Small differences from one fit per cutoff are not significance tests. These reused development holdouts do not assess the newly admitted low-VID population or genuinely unobserved layers.
Reproduction, counts and verification

Both sweeps completed successfully and their GPU workers were verified terminated. Host and CloudWatch safeguards used a three-hour idle limit and a separate 24-hour runtime limit. Checks confirmed matching evaluation counts for all 160 threshold × group × depth comparisons, identical recomputed baseline metrics, and matching training-row counts.

Hyperparameters: depth 10, eta 0.05, min-child-weight 20, lambda 5; patience 300. Run collect.py, then Rscript render.R in analysis/threshold-comparison/. Source is report.Rmd; checks are recorded in verification.json. Preparation and run details are in the repository’s threshold-sweep and low-VID-sweep documentation.
